commercialUseBasis: Original procedural Blender geometry/materials. ComfyUI core scaling only. No external pixels, meshes, checkpoints or custom nodes.
collision: Exact DATA_ARENA_MAP and createDataArenaGrid remain gameplay authority.
occlusion: Southern solid-footprint edge sorts each tall structure and crane. Ground shadows are baked separately. Mechanism frames carry their own changing shadow.

motion.reducedMotion: Freeze waves, localized caustics, mechanism frames and quiet lamps; gameplay telegraphs remain active.

artDirection.composition: approximate 60/30/10 dominant/secondary/accent guidance; not pixel quotas
artDirection.dominant: quiet warm stone, wood and soft water
artDirection.secondary: structural copper and grouped muted cloth
artDirection.accent: small fixtures; character, skill and important HUD feedback remain strongest
